value.rationale: A natural marginal-rate uncertainty in an existing local-reset interacting-particle system is resolved by a sharp theta=1 phase boundary, four density asymptotic classes, an explicit universal beta family for the condensate fitness gap, and a double-logarithmic scaling law at the new critical point. It distinguishes macroscopically identical endpoint atoms by physically motivated nested scales; the answer is neither an arbitrary isolated invariant nor a rephrasing of the pure-power classification.
